name: @pipeworx/mcp-tn-dmv

tools.name: tn_dmv_driver_service_centers
tools.description: Find Tennessee driver service centers (Department of Safety and Homeland Security) with street address, county, hours, phone, coordinates, and exactly which services each of the 186 locations performs. Tennessee publishes a per-location capability matrix, so this answers questions a plain address list cannot: "which Tennessee driver service center issues a REAL ID", "where can I take the CDL skills test in Tennessee", "which Tennessee location does handgun permits", "where do I get a vision test near Knoxville", or "is there a driver services kiosk in Memphis". Locations split into full service centers, self-service kiosks, county clerk partners and express counters. Filter by city, county, ZIP, name or required service; call with no arguments for all 186.

city.description: City name, e.g. "Nashville", "Oak Ridge". Matched loosely, so spacing does not matter.

county.description: Tennessee county name, matched as a substring, e.g. "Davidson", "Shelby".

zip.description: Five-digit Tennessee ZIP code, or a prefix, e.g. "37830".

service.description: Require a service, matched as a substring. Published services: REAL ID, new application, photo ID, handgun permit, vision test, road or motorcycle test, knowledge test, CDL skills test, renewal, name change, address change, graduated license upgrade, duplicate license, motor vehicle report, set up a payment plan, pay reinstatement fees, submit reinstatement documentation, full service, express service, third-party testing, self-service kiosk.

tools.name: tn_dmv_impaired_driving_crashes
tools.description: Count Tennessee injury and fatal traffic crashes involving alcohol or drugs, from the Department of Safety and Homeland Security crash file for calendar year 2022. Each record is one person involved in an impaired-driving crash, carrying crash severity (fatal, suspected serious injury, suspected minor injury), the driver age group and gender, the investigating law-enforcement agency, date, time and coordinates. Answers "how many fatal DUI crashes in Tennessee", "which age group is involved in the most alcohol-related crashes in Tennessee", "drug-involved crashes by police agency", or "impaired driving crashes by month". Group results by age_group, gender, severity, agency, substance or month, and get a sample of the underlying records with latitude and longitude for mapping.

substance.description: "alcohol", "drugs", "both" (alcohol and drugs together), or "either" (default — any impairment).

age_group.description: Age band substring as published, e.g. "21 to 24", "80 & Up", "16 to 17".

agency.description: Investigating agency substring. State troopers are published as "THP District 3 - Nashville" and similar, so "THP" selects all of them; city forces read "METROPOLITAN NASHVILLE POLICE DEPT", "MEMPHIS POLICE DEPT"; counties read "SHERIFF".

group_by.description: Breakdown dimension: age_group, gender, severity, agency, substance, month. Defaults to age_group.

limit.description: Max sample records returned alongside the counts (default 10, max 200).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tn-dmv forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tn-dmv pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
